structuralFindings: Structurally very different from the 2026 card: priced PER ROOM (2 pax standard, Royal Suite max 4 pax) across 3 seasons (Regular/Peak/Festive) rather than 2026's Year-Round/Festive split, and season windows are named differently (no more 'Year Round 08 Jan-20 Dec' block — instead 'Regular Season' explicitly lists Mar/Apr/May/Jun/Sep/Oct/Nov/Dec-to-15th, and 'Peak Season' is Jan15-Feb28 AND Jul1-Aug31 combined under one price).

No Twin/Double vs Single split shown on this card the way 2026 had it — Single travelers instead get a flat 20% reduction off the double-occupancy rate per the notes section, a different mechanism than 2026's separate Single Room Rate rows.

No separate 'Per Triple Room (2 Adults 1 Child)' pricing row exists on this 2027 card — the room rate appears to be the base 2-pax price for Superior/Deluxe/Junior Suite, with Royal Suite listed as 'Max 4 pax' at one flat price (not broken out by occupancy count the way 2026 was).

Meal plan: Regular & Peak Season = Half Board; Easter & Festive Season = Full Board, min 5 nights — same underlying concept as 2026's Year-Round HB / Festive FB, but season boundaries don't line up 1:1 with the 2026 card's Year-Round/Festive dates.

Cancellation policy tightened materially vs 2026: 90+ days now the ONLY no-charge band (2026 had multiple graduated softer bands down to 20% at 90-60 days); No Show is 100% (same); deposit requirement rose from 20% (2026) to 50% (2027).
New 'Day Use' policy appears on this 2027 card with no 2026 equivalent: 75% of applicable room rate, checkout 17:00, KES 3,000 non-redeemable pool charge.
Child policy text is near-identical to 2026's (0-3 free, 4-11 sharing = 50%, 4-11 own room = 75% max 3 children, single adult + child = single rate + 50%), confirmed matching wording on this page.
